details: This package is a self-declared proof-of-concept that executes index.js from its postinstall hook on install. The script prints the installer's hostname and current working directory to the console and then sends an HTTP POST to a public webhook capture endpoint, hxxps://webhook[.]site/b4ea4473-01d9-4763-9e39-3b02063219d5. The POST body contains only a randomly generated test identifier plus the fixed strings "authorized-poc-test" and "executed"; it does not read environment variables, files, credentials, tokens or wallet data, and none of the host metadata it prints locally is transmitted to any remote host.
